pythonFunction.name: check_ancp_enrollment
pythonFunction.description:
Checks whether a service address is enrolled in the Automatic Name Change Program (ANCP), which
affects how a move or start is handled: when the landlord is enrolled the account transfers without
interruption and the tenant submits a move-in order on the customer portal. Before calling this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase while it
runs.

Args:
    address: The standardized service address (REQUIRED).

Returns:
    dict with ok, found, ancp_enrolled and, when enrolled, agent_action.
